minutes.headline: Planning Board voted by roll call to adopt the Master Plan Steering Committee charge, with two wording changes.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board finalized the composition and charge of the Master Plan steering committee (one member each from Planning and Select Boards, library trustees swapped for housing authority, six at-large seats). It discussed what kinds of people to seek for the at-large seats, then heard committee reports and a Pond View update. Minutes for May 8 and a public hearing were approved and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted by roll call, all aye, to adopt the Master Plan steering committee charge with two wording changes.
The two changes state that the master plan is the Planning Board's statutory responsibility and replace the committee's timeframe with 18 to 24 months.
The board discussed what kinds of people to seek for the six at-large seats, and expects to appoint them after the June 15 kickoff meeting.
A school committee member said about half the town budget goes to schools and argued for at least one school representative on the committee.
The board will reorganize and update its MJTC representative at the next meeting, and assign its member to the master plan committee.

why_it_matters: The master plan steering committee will shape the town's long-range plan, and the charge adopted here sets who sits on it and how long it has to work.
Because schools take about half the town budget, whether the committee includes a school representative affects how the plan treats school costs and facilities.
watch_next: The June 15 kickoff meeting of the master plan steering committee, after which the at-large members are expected to be appointed.
The board's next meeting, where it will reorganize, update its MJTC representative and assign its member to the master plan committee.
